edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff Four Hundred Twenty-Five Thousand Dollars (US $425,000) (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff within five (5) business days after the Effective Date.

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. edits.name: Release timing revision

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY.
